hero.sub: Milestone escrow for deals between strangers. / An AI verifies the evidence. / A deterministic engine moves the money. / Every decision is signed and anchored.
hero.whyChain: Money never touches the chain. Rupees move on Razorpay the entire time. The chain holds exactly two things: the rulebook of the deal, so neither party can quietly edit it after the fact, and a fingerprint of every AI decision, so the claim that an AI decided can be replaced with a verifiable record.
hero.fixtureProvider: scored by the deterministic offline adapter - no model key configured

hero.whyChainTitle: The money never touches the chain.
pillars: Rupees move on Razorpay from start to finish. There is no token, no coin and nothing to stake.
The chain holds the rulebook of the deal, so neither side can quietly edit the terms after the evidence arrives.
The chain holds a fingerprint of every AI decision, so “an AI decided” can be replaced with a record anyone can re-check.

section.verifierLede: A machine that must always answer will guess. / So UNVERIFIABLE is a first-class verdict: the evidence neither supports nor contradicts the clause, and the system says so. / A required UNVERIFIABLE clause can never auto-release, and it can never auto-reject either.
section.quote: 4 photograph(s) cannot establish a count of 500; nothing in the pixels evidences a total, and nothing contradicts it either.
section.quoteAttr: ESCALATED AT CONFIDENCE {confidence} · NO MONEY MOVED
section.scaleRule: Below the reject line, and still not rejected: an UNVERIFIABLE verdict never auto-settles either way. It goes to a person.
section.invariantsLede: Every one of these is enforced in code and proven by a test. / Two are proven the hard way: CI plants a real violation and requires the check to fail before restoring it.
section.measuredLede: Across a held-out corpus with fifty adversarial bundles, scored once. / The calibration was fitted on a separate corpus generated with a different seed, so this is a measurement rather than a fit reported as one.
section.measuredNote: Every figure above is read from the JSON that `make eval` wrote, not typed here. The cost is a projection from measured token counts at pinned list prices; the measured spend is zero, because this run used the deterministic offline adapter and called no provider.

footer.statement2: “an AI decided” is not an audit answer.
